theorems.statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → G '' A ⊆ R.carrier → ∃ s : Euclid n → ℤ, Measurable s ∧ (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) ∧ ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))) * R.orient (G u) α = (s u : ℝ) * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
